Commentary.Commentary: Right then, England have a target of 257 to chase to save themselves from the embarrassment of losing their first series after the high of World Cup. The pitch is a bit sluggish in nature and South Africa will be hoping that they have enough on the board to defend. Do join us in a short while to find out how the run chase pans out...

The English bowling was on the mark for most parts. Every bowler was impressive, especially the spinners. Moeen Ali and Adil Rashid combined for 4 wickets in 20 overs where they gave away just 93 runs. The pitch also assisted their type of bowling and they took full advantage. Towards the end, Chris Jordan received a stick but his initial overs were very accurate and tidy. A word of praise for Tom Curran who was brilliant at both ends of the innings. It came as a surprise that the debutant Saqib Mahmood was not given any over at the death.

After being put into bat, South Africa were going decently till the first Drinks break as Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma formed an alliance. But the picture changed completely in the next hour after that. Both batsmen got dismissed and Rassie van der Dussen also flopped. JJ Smuts played his shots but failed to convert his start into something substantial. With the African innings falling apart, David Miller took the onus on himself and stuck to the task of bailing the home team out. He formed a partnership with Andile Phehlukwayo but the one with Lutho Sipamla offered the real impetus to the Protean innings.

Killer Miller! What a striker! When he is on song, it's a treat to watch! In this Pink ODI, David turned up in full force. He started slowly but once he got his eyes in, we witnessed some clean striking from the southpaw. He brought the heat in this contest and South Africa have taken some great momentum towards the end of the innings.

SIX! He has nailed it into the crowd! What a strike to finish the innings. Full and around off, in the swinging arc of Miller. He stays deep in his crease and smokes it over deep mid-wicket for a huge six. The 50-run stand comes up. Excellent finish to the final over for the hosts. South Africa finish on 256/7.
Says no to the run! Full and on middle, he forces it to long on. The ball goes to the fielder really fast and on one bounce. Miller denies the run. Let's see what he can do on the final ball.

Shortish in length and slower in pace, Sipamla looks to smash it down the ground but mistimes it. The ball goes towards mid off and a run is taken. 250 up for the hosts. Good thing for South Africa is that Miller is back on strike.
Full and wide outside off, Miller strokes it towards backward point and takes a single.

Swing and a miss! This was in the slot and Miller would feel he missed out on this one. A length ball just outside off, Miller winds up and targets the shorter side of the ground but he fails to connect.

SIX! Smashed out of the park! What a strike from Miller on the first ball. It is a slower one and outside off, Miller spots that early. He goes deep in his crease and tonks it over deep mid-wicket for a huge maximum.
Full ball on middle, Miller whips it towards deep square leg for a single. 4 runs off the penultimate over, another excellent one from Curran.
DROPPED! A tough one though. A full toss on middle, Sipamla drills it back to the bowler. The ball hits the hands and rolls towards mid off. A single taken.
Edged but does not carry! Another back of the hand ball around off, Sipamla looks to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards the keeper on the bounce.

A couple now! It should've been three but Sipamla is once again not ready! A full ball around off, Sipamla this time reads it well and launches it over mid off. The fielder chases it down and returns the ball to the keeper. Miller there wanted the third but Sipamla was slow during the running between the wickets and they ended with only 2.
Shortish and around off, Sipamla blocks it off his back foot.

Uppish but safe! What was Jason Roy doing there? A slower one around off, Sipamla just checks his shot. The ball hits the upper part of his bat and lobs toward Roy at point. He does not try to catch the ball and it bounces in front of him.

FOUR! Brilliant finish to the over from Miller! Full toss wide outside off, Miller thumps it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder from long on tries to get to the ball but fails to come across. It bounces wide of him and goes to the fence. 14 from the over, another expensive one by Jordan.
Shortish and around middle, Sipamla tucks it towards the leg side and takes a single.
WIDE! Fuller and wide outside off, Sipamla throws his bat at it but fails to connect. Wided by the umpire.
Another very full ball on middle, Miller whips it to deep mid-wicket and gets to the other end. He wanted the second but Sipamla was slow to respond.

FIFTY FOR DAVID MILLER! 13th in ODIs. He started really slowly but is now providing the much-needed flourish to this South African innings. Short and outside off, Miller slaps it through point and scampers back for the second to reach the landmark. This is his first score of 50 or more since November 2018.
FOUR! Whipped! What a shot this is from Miller! Low full toss on middle, Miller whips it off his pads and finds the gap at square leg and mid-wicket with perfection.
Shortish ball around middle, Sipamla tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets Miller back on strike.
Full and outside off, Sipamla squeezes it out to third man for a run. Just 4 from the 47th over.
Shortish and on middle, Miller pulls it to deep square leg by rolling his wrists. A single taken.
Risky run! Fuller and slower one again, Sipamla pushes it towards mid off and takes off. The fielder fires the throw at the striker's end but misses. Miller though dives to make his ground.
Fuller and slower one around off, Sipamla can only block it back to the bowler.
Good length ball around off, Sipamla blocks it onto the pitch.
Full and around off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Tom Curran is back on! 7-1-30-0 from him so far.
Full and around off, Miller jams it out and takes a run to keep the strike. Good over for South Africa, 12 off it.
Short and wide outside off, this time Miller punches it wide of the deep cover for a couple of runs.
SIX! Whacked! Short and slow outside off, Miller rocks on the back foot and pulls it over deep mid-wicket to get his second maximum of the innings.
Good length ball around off, Sipamla looks to defend but the ball takes the outer half of the bat and goes to third man for a run.
Leading edge but safe! A slower one on a good length and on middle, Miller looks to work it on the leg side but the ball takes the leading edge and goes towards covers. A single taken.
Length ball on the pads, Sipamla tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Chris Jordan returns in action. 6-0-19-0 are his outstanding figures so far.

FOUR! Good end to the over. Floated on off, Miller sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. Salty end to Rashid's spell but he has had a fine day with the ball. He finishes with the figures of 10-0-51-3.
Lutho Sipamla is the new man in.

OUT! Run Out! Suicidal run and South Africa lose another wicket. The good news for the home fans is that it is Beuran Hendricks who walks back and not Miller. Tossed up on the pads, Miller flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick run. Miller calls his partner for the second but Rashid himself gets to the ball quickly. He sends in a good throw at the bowler's end. Credit to Morgan as well as he comes up to the stumps from mid off. Hendricks puts in a dive but he is so short of his crease that the umpire does not even bother to go upstairs.
On the pads, Beuran looks to flick but misses. The ball kisses his pads and goes to the leg side for a leg bye.
Miller comes down the track to take it on the full. But he cannot get under it properly and gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball goes fine down the leg side and they take a run.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Beuran looks to flick but gets a leading edge which goes towards long off for a single.
200 up for South Africa. Flatter on the pads, Miller glances it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Miller keeps the strike. On the middle, Miller flicks it to the on side and takes a run.
SIX! Bang, this is out of here. Tossed up on off, Miller gets down on his knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a maximum. He's been struggling but this should get him going.
Flatter on off and middle, Miller comes down the track and blocks it.
Quick run and in the end they get it. Flighted on off, Beuran defends it towards point. Miller urges him to come out for a single and he obliges. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
On the pads, Miller turns it to fine leg for a run.
Floated on middle, Miller defends it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and around off, Hendricks pushes it back to the bowler. 3 runs and a wicket from it, another successful one for Rashid and England.
Googly around off, Hendricks fails to read the variation as he looks to defend but the ball hits his thigh pad and goes to Root at first slip on the bounce.
On the pads, pushed towards long on for a single.
Full and on middle, Hendricks pushes it to long on for a single to get off the mark.
Into the bowlers now and the first one to come out to bat is Beuran Hendricks.

OUT! LBW! Phehlukwayo is gone! Another very full ball on middle, Phehlukwayo goes for the reverse sweep but fails to connect. He is hit right in front of the sticks. Rashid appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Phehlukwayo has a word with his partner and then he goes for the DRS. Replays roll in. This time we have the Ultra Edge and it detects that there is no bat involved. It is pitched in line. Where is it hitting? Just brushing the off pole, so it's the umpire's call on hitting the wickets. South Africa keep their review but lose Phehlukwayo. Rashid has his third.

Phehlukwayo has been given out LBW! He has reviewed it after having a long chat with his partner at the other end. Replay time! Ultra Edge shows there's no bat in it. It's pitched in line, umpire's call on hitting the wickets, so Phehlukwayo has to go.
Rashid starts with a very full ball outside off, Miller strokes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Adil Rashid (8-0-40-2) returns!
On the pads, Miller clips it behind square leg for a run. End of a brilliant over from Root. Just 2 runs off it.
Full and on middle, Miller sweeps but finds square leg.
Another fuller one from Root, Phehlukwayo pushes it towards covers and takes a quick run.
Fuller and outside off again, Phehlukwayo looks to drive but the ball takes the inner half and hits his pads.
Full and on off, it is blocked.
Short and around off, Phehlukwayo looks to reverse pull but misses.
Quick run! Length ball around off, Phehlukwayo pushes it towards the off side and takes a quick run.
Length ball on off and middle, Phehlukwayo finds mid-wicket with his flick shot.
Shortish one on the body, Phehlukwayo blocks it onto the pitch.
Good length ball on middle, Miller turns it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and around off, Phehlukwayo strokes it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Flicked nicely! Length ball on middle, Phehlukwayo flicks it uppishly past the man at mid on. Once the ball goes past that fielder, it races away to the fence.
Time for the final phase of the innings. Powerplay 3 signaled by the umpire. Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Fuller and outside off, Phehlukwayo once again goes for the slog but this time he gets an under edge. The ball goes to short third man and a run is taken.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid on.
On the pads, Miller works it towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and around off, pushed to covers.
Full and around off, Phehlukwayo pushes it past the man at covers and calls for two. However, the fielder from long off does really well to get to the ball and keep the batters to just a single.
Swing and a miss! Flighted ball outside off, Phehlukwayo winds up for a massive heave but makes no connection as the ball turns away a hint.

Quick run! Short and on middle, Phehlukwayo goes on the back foot and blocks it onto the pitch. They attempt to steal a quick run and manage to do so as Curran fails to kick the ball at the stumps at the striker's end.
WIDE! Curran bowls another length ball down the leg side. Phehlukwayo looks to flick but misses.
Good length ball around off, pushed to mid off.
Good length ball on middle, this time Miller works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Miller looks to glance but misses. Wided.
Fuller and on the pads, Phehlukwayo looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and a leg bye is taken.
Shortish ball around middle, Phehlukwayo once again finds mid-wicket after playing his flick.
Length ball around off, Phehlukwayo works it towards mid-wicket.
Tom Curran (5-1-19-0) is back on!
Slower through the air and around off, Miller comes forward and blocks it out.
Full and around off, Miller comes down the track and blocks it towards the bowler.
Another single as Phehlukwayo pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Miller strokes it towards cover for a run.
Full and around off, Phehlukwayo pushes it towards long off for a single.
Play and a miss! Root fires a full ball just outside off, Phehlukwayo looks to launch it over long off but misses.
Joe Root is back on. Expensive day for him so far as he has gone for 25 from his 3 overs. Can he add a wicket as a sweetener and make a comeback?
On the pads, Phehlukwayo flicks it towards square leg and keeps the strike. 6 from the over.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Andile pushes it to cover.
On the stumps, Phehlukwayo defends it.
Bit of extra bounce on this one. Jordan hits the deck hard on middle and leg, Phehlukwayo looks to defend but the ball shoots up and hits the upper half of Andile's bat.
FOUR LEG BYES! Jordan bowls it on the leg side, Phehlukwayo looks to flick but the ball kisses the thigh pad and goes fine down the leg side to the fine leg fence.
WIDE! Jordan this time goes extra wide outside off. Phehlukwayo shoulders arms to it as it is on the wrong side of the tram line.
Length ball outside off, Phehlukwayo leaves it alone.
Tossed up on off, Miller defends it to get through the over. Moeen Ali finishes with 42/1 in his 10 overs.
FOUR! Bounces just inside the ropes. Flighted on off, Miller gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it over square keg for a boundary.
Phehlukwayo is off the mark. Tossed up on off, Phehlukwayo strokes it to long off for one.
On the stumps, Andile defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Phehlukwayo blocks it off the front foot to start his innings.

Another risky run. Tossed up on middle, Miller pushes it to the right of mid on and calls for a quick run. The fielder at mid on sends a bad throw at the keeper's end allowing Phehlukwayo to get in with ease.
Andile Phehlukwayo joins David Miller.

OUT! RUN OUT! South Africa are falling apart. They say that never run off a misfield, Smuts did just that and has to head back to the pavilion. A full ball on middle, Smuts whips it towards mid-wicket where Banton makes a diving stop to his right. However, it is a half-stop and the ball rolls to his right. Both the batters take off initially but Miller for some reason sends him back. Smuts needs to return and has to cover a lot of ground. In the meantime, Banton gets up and throws the ball to the keeper. Bairstow collects and whips the bails off as Smuts tries to make in with a dive. The third umpire has been called. The replays roll in and show that the dive has not saved Smuts and he has to go. A promising knock has been nipped in the bud.
It's going to be a big blow for the Saffas as Smuts was going on nicely and his presence would have helped to up the scoring ante.
Run out appeal taken upstairs. That looks out. Replays roll in and show that Smuts is short.
Full and on off, pushed towards mid off for a quick single.
Length ball outside off, Miller this time makes a leave.
Play and a miss again! Fullish and just outside off, this time for the left-hander. Miller goes for the drive but the ball this time shapes back in. It beats the inside edge and goes to the keeper.
Good length ball on middle, it moves away after pitching. Smuts looks to turn it on the leg side but it takes the leading edge and goes towards the off side. A run taken.
Play and a miss! Poor attempt from Smuts. A fuller ball outside off, Smuts goes after the ball to drive but fails to connect.
Chris Jordan (4-0-15-0) is back on!

DRINKS! We had asked if de Kock and Bavuma would stay till this break or will we see England denting their momentum? Looking at the scorecard, one can say that the visitors did dent the momentum with a few quick strikes. They have got the massive wicket of de Kock in this hour too. Miller and Smuts are out in the middle and are trying to stitch a stand to take back the control of the game.
Flatter one around off, Miller pushes it towards covers.
Short one on middle, Smuts pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Shortish and around off, Smuts tucks it straight to mid-wicket again.
Fuller and around off and middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Flighted ball on middle, Miller pushes it towards long off for a single.
EDGED AND FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Smuts looks to cut but the ball goes off the outside edge wide of Root at first slip. The ball has the legs to go to the third man fence.
On the pads, Smuts flicks it towards mid-wicket. Miller comes out for a run but he is sent back. The fielder sends a decent throw but Adil fails to collect it and gets hit on the shoulder.
Tossed up on middle, Miller milks it to long on for one.
On the stumps, Miller defends it off the front foot.
Floated on off, Smuts pushes it to cover and gets a single.

In the air but safe. Full toss from Moeen. Smuts looks to go over long off but it goes off the top edge of his willow. Jordan runs behind it but the ball evades him and he gets there on the bounce. Two taken by the batters.
Beauty to end the over. Quicker and shorter on off, Miller looks to defend but the ball turns away and just about misses the outside edge of Miller's bat.
Short on off, Smuts punches it to cover-point for a single.
On the stumps, Smuts blocks it.
Tossed up on off, Smuts lunges forward and hits it straight but too straight as it is sent back to Moeen.
Flighted on off, Miller nudges it to long off and gets a single.
Darted around the pads, Miller glances it to square leg.

Quick run! Another fuller ball around middle, Miller flicks it towards mid-wicket where the fielder fumbles and seeing that they take off for the run. The fielder gets up quickly and fires the throw at the non-striker's end but misses. Direct hit would've made things interesting.
Slower one on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller and around off, this time Miller finds covers.
Full and around off, Miller pushes it towards mid off.
David Miller is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Rashid strikes and it's the big wicket of the Protea skipper! Brilliant loopy ball on middle, de Kock fancies and thinks to send Rashid out of the park but fails in his attempt. Rashid pitches it full and on middle, de Kock makes room and looks to go inside out. However, the ball turns in sharply to beat his attempt. It goes behind and castles the stumps. England have got rid of another good-looking stand in time.
Fuller and around off, Smuts pushes it towards covers and takes a quick run.
Full and around off, de Kock comes forward and blocks it onto the pitch.
Short and wide outside off, de Kock strokes it towards covers.

FOUR! Misfield! Tom Curran is one of the best fielders going around in the world but that was poor from him. Floated on middle and leg, de Kock flicks it through mid-wicket. Tom Curran in the deep runs to his right and tries to take it but he misses and the ball goes past him for a boundary. The South African fans are having fun and they love every bit of it.
On the pads, it is flicked towards mid-wicket.

Direct hit but safe! Full ball around off, Smuts drills it towards mid off and takes off for a single. Jordan picks the ball, fires the throw at the non-striker's end and scores a direct hit but the on-field umpire says he is in. Replays confirm the same.
Slower through the air and around off, Smuts block it off the front foot.
Fuller and on the pads, Smuts turns it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Flatter and on the pads, worked towards the leg side for a run.

A couple now! That looked a clean strike but it wasn't. A full ball around off for de Kock. He looks to clear the long off fence but mistimes it. The ball drops well ahead of the ropes and stops. A couple taken before long on can mop it up.
Full and around off, this time he eases a single to long off.

SIX! That is a flat six! Smuts finally makes a clean connection. It is a full ball in the slot, Smuts clears his front leg and whacks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. His first one of the innings.
Fuller and around off, Smuts blocks it out.
On the pads, Smuts flicks it to the leg side and keeps the strike.
Short around off, de Kock cuts it through point for single.
Tossed up on middle, Smuts strokes it to long on for a single.

In the air...and safe. Short around off, de Kock gets on his back foot and looks to pull. He does not time it at all and it goes off the upper half of his bat. It goes to the left of long on. Jordan there cannot get to the ball on the full and takes it on the bounce. The batsmen cross.
Tossed up on off, de Kock defends it with a straight bat.
Floated on middle, de Kock makes room and drives it to extra cover.
Full and loopy ball outside off, de Kock drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and on the pads, Smuts paddles it to fine leg for a single.

Just past the stumps! Brilliant bowling from Rashid and Smuts is unable to read him. A loopy ball around off, Smuts looks to defend but the ball spins and goes past his defensive bat. It goes just over the stumps. Bairstow does well to pouch the ball to his left.
Fires it outside off, Smuts lets it be.
Flatter and on middle, de Kock tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
Full and around off and middle, Smuts pushes it towards long on for a run.
Loopy ball around off, de Kock blocks it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
SIX! Thump! Poor ball from Ali and de Kock takes full toll. Short and on middle, de Kock rocks on the back foot and hammers it via pull over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Short and wide outside off, this time de Kock goes on the back foot and slaps it wide of the man at deep point. Before the fielder can come across to mop, a couple taken.
Around off, de Kock comes on the front foot and keeps it out.
Full and outside off, it is stroked towards covers.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
FIFTY! On the pads of de Kock, he flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a run. 50 up for de Kock, his 25th in this format. He is continuing his good form!
Flights this one just outside off on a fuller length, Smuts looks to go downtown but misses. The ball goes past his bat and then deflects off Bairstow's gloves to fine leg. A bye taken.
Flighted ball on middle, Smuts looks to turn it to the leg side but the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards short third man.
Full and outside off, de Kock strokes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full ball around off, Smuts strokes it to long off for a single.
Loopy full ball on middle, de Kock defends it out.
On the pads, flicked to the leg side for a run.
Short and wide outside off, de Kock cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter and around off and middle, Smuts tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Full and on middle, de Kock strokes it towards mid on for a run. 100 up for the hosts with that run.
Loopy ball on the pads, de Kock looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
On the stumps, Smuts is in no hurry after fetching himself a boundary off the previous ball and defends this calmly.

FOUR! Release shot and it releases some pressure. Flighted on off, Smuts has no clue where it is spinning so he gets down and plays the sweep shot which goes past the diving man at short 45 on the leg side for a boundary. There is an old saying, if you are clueless against spinners, sweep.
Tossed up on off, Smuts defends it back to the bowler.
Quicker one on middle, Smuts defends it.
Flighted on middle and leg, de Kock glances it to the leg side and gets a single.
Flighted leg spinner outside off, de Kock looks to defend but misses.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
JJ Smuts is the new man in.

OUT! Timber! Van der Dussen cannot make use of the chance he got and it is Moeen Ali who sends him packing. This time we don't need any DRS for it as Moeen has pegged back the stumps of van der Dussen. Ali bowls a quicker one on middle, Rassie looks to stroke it down the ground off his back foot. He though misses to connect as the ball turns and it goes between his bat and pad to disturb the woodwork. The English players are clearly pumped up and that probably is because they were not happy with Rassie returning after given out in the previous over. Van der Dussen walks back with a sendoff. South Africa after being in the driver's seat are suddenly under pressure. The two spinners are now all over the Proteas.
FOUR! This time he connects with the reverse sweep and finds the fence. Full and outside off, Rassie gets in position and sweeps it past the man at backward point for a boundary.
Shortish and around off, van der Dussen blocks it off the back foot.
Short and wide outside off, van der Dussen makes a leave.
Full ball outside off, Rassie goes for the reverse sweep but finds the short third man fielder.
Rassie is off the mark now! A low full toss on middle, van der Dussen flicks it to mid on for a single. End of a successful over from Rashid.
Full ball on off, it is pushed towards covers.

DRAMA! Plenty of drama! A wicket has been overturned. Rashid serves it on a fuller length close to off and van der Dussen fails to pick it. He stretches forward to defend but misses as the ball spins past the inside edge and pings him on the front pad. They appeal, the umpire thinks and thinks and thinks... before raising his finger! Rashid is delighted. There is no review left so Rassie has to walk back. He's on his bike. HANG ON! South Africa are awarded a review here. Reason - There was no Ultra Edge available on the last dismissal, so the home team has been granted a referral. Time to refer it upstairs and the Ball Tracker finds it to be missing the leg stump. Fair decision has been made in the end and this is what matters the most. Carry on, plenty of time has been lost in this drama already.
Rassie van der Dussen replaces Bavuma.

OUT! LBW! Bavuma has to depart! He fails to read the googly and gets hit on the pads in front of the stumps. Rashid and the other English players make a loud appeal once again. This time the umpire agrees and raises his fingers. Bavuma gets to the other end to have a chat with his skipper. They then signal the 'T'. Time for the replays. First up, front foot. And it's fine. Is there an inside edge? Replays show there seems nothing although without the Ultra Edge. Where is it pitching? In the line of the stumps. Hitting the stumps? Yes, it is. Three reds and Bavuma has to go. He starts walking but the umpire asks him to wait. Why? Because Ultra Edge is not there to confirm, he stands for a while and the replay rolls in again. Ultra Edge is still unavailable and Bavuma has been told to carry on with his walk back to the pavilion. Review lost also? Not sure. South Africa will feel hard done if they lose it as there was only half technology available.

Bavuma has been adjudged LBW and after a chat with de Kock he has taken the DRS. This indicates there is no bat involved. Let's see what the replays have to say. The Ultra Edge is not available it seems and after Ball Tracker shows that it is all reds Bavuma starts walking back. But hold on he gets near the ropes and has been told to wait. He waits and still there is no Ultra Edge and after a brief wait, the umpire has raised his finger.

Huge appeal for LBW! Not out says the umpire. A slider around off, Bavuma looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. Rashid and others make a loud appeal but not out says the umpire. Morgan comes quickly towards the bowler and the keeper to have a chat regarding the DRS. They decide against it.
Flatter one on the pads, de Kock works it towards the leg side for a run.
Loopy ball around off, Bavuma comes down the track and strokes it well but it is straight to mid off.
Loopy ball around off, Bavuma prods forward to block it out.
Short and wide outside off, de Kock punches it to deep point for a run.
Full and on middle, Bavuma pushes it towards mid on and calls for a quick single.
Flatter and on the pads, Bavuma looks to reverse sweep but misses. The ball turns down the leg side by some margin. It kisses the pad and goes to Bairstow behind.
Full and on middle, de Kock flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off and middle, de Kock nudges it to long on for a single. He will keep the strike.
Floated on off, de Kock looks to defend but gets a leading edge which goes towards extra cover.

EDGED AND DROPPED. A very difficult chance. Short outside off, Bavuma looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge which goes quickly past the right of Root at first slip. Moeen gives it a chase and manages to pull it back before the ropes with a slide. Saves a run for his side. Replay later on shows that Root gets a finger to it which took the pace off the ball. Technically a drop.
Flighted on off, Temba defends it with soft hands to the off side and looks for a run but de Kock says no.
Tossed up outside off, it is a leg spinner. Bavuma strokes it to mid off.
Rashid starts with a flighted ball on the pads, de Kock flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Adil Rashid comes to bowl now. He is playing his 100th ODI in English colors. 1 slip in place.
Flighted on off, de Kock taps it towards covers and gets a single to end the over. 4 from his first over back in England colors.
Tossed up on off, Temba milks it to long on for a run.
Flighted on off, Bavuma pushes it straight back to Moeen.
Shorter on off, de Kock tucks it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Flighted outside off, Bavuma strokes it to deep point and gets to the other end with ease.
Moeen starts with a flighted delivery on off, Bavuma defends and looks for a quick run but his skipper sends him back.
Moeen Ali, on return to the ODI side, will start for England post this mini-break.

Drinks! An excellent hour of cricket! Curran troubled de Kock early on but the Protea skipper has his eyes set now. Mahmood removed Hendricks for his debut scalp but after that, de Kock and Bavuma are looking solid out in the middle. The duo has already added 53 runs and are looking in good touch. Let's see if they can carry on till the next Drinks break or not.

SIX! De Kock brings up the 50-run stand in style. A trademark de Kock flick from the South African skipper. Jordan bowls it slightly full on the pads, Quinton loves it there. He lofts his flick stylishly over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. South African accelerating here. 16 runs off the last two overs.
Beaten! Length ball just outside off, de Kock looks to cut but it is too close to his body and luckily for him and his side he does not edge that one.
Length delivery on top of the stumps, de Kock taps it back to the bowler.
On the stumps, Quinton blocks it with a dead bat.
Good length ball on off, de Kock defends it with a straight bat.
WIDE! Jordan misses his line and sends one down the leg side. De Kock looks to flick but misses.

Direct hit and it would have been close. Length ball outside off, Bavuma shuffles across to his off pole and nudges it towards mid on. He takes off for a single, Tom Curran there charges to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses the stumps but the ball hits the hip of Bavuma. He is bruised but seems fine to continue.
Flighted on the stumps, Quinny defends it to get through the over. Another 8 off Root's over.
Around the pads, Bavuma turns it to the on side and gets to the other end.
Smartly follows the boundary with a single towards cover.

FOUR! Exhibition of de Kock's craftsmanship. Short and just outside off, de Kock waits for it and then guides it wide of slip and backward point for a boundary. Not an easy shot to play but de Kock's class makes it look very easy.
On the pads, Bavuma flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, de Kock looks to defend but the ball skids in and takes the inside edge of his bat. It goes towards square leg and they take a single.
Around off, Bavuma defends it to get through the over safely. Just a run from CJ's third over.
Length delivery outside off, Temba shoulders arms to it.
Good length ball outside off, it shapes away. Bavuma does not disturb that and leaves it alone.
Good length ball on off, Bavuma defends it towards point.
Good running. Once again Jordan goes full on off, de Kock taps it to the off side and calls for a quick run. Bavuma responds and they get it with ease.
Fuller on off, de Kock defends it towards covers and shouts a loud no to his partner.

FOUR! Sublime! Bavuma has been in great form of late and he is looking in excellent touch once again. Root bowls a fuller ball around off, Bavuma gets to the pitch and strokes it through the gap between the cover and mid off fielders. 8 from the over, another decent one for the Proteas.
Loopy fuller ball outside off, de Kock drives it to deep cover for a single.
Short and on middle, Bavuma pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and just around off, de Kock guides it towards short third man off his back foot and takes a quick single.
Shortish and on middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Full ball on middle, Bavuma eases a single to long off and gets to the non-striker's end.
Full and just outside off, de Kock strokes it towards mid on.
Quick run! Fuller in length and around off, Bavuma tucks it towards mid-wicket and calls for a run. They complete it easily.
In the channel outside off, Bavuma makes a leave now.
Length ball around off, Bavuma defends it off his back foot.
50 up for South Africa! Full ball on middle, de Kock flicks it to the man at deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Fuller and around off, it is pushed towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Cut away! Short and outside off, de Kock goes on the back foot and slams it through point for a boundary. 9 from Root's first over, not a good start from him in this game.
Full and around off, pushed to covers.

EDGY FOUR! There's the edge, there's the chance but there is no one at slip. A flighted ball around off, spinning away. De Kock looks to drive but gets a thick outside off. The ball goes past the short third man fielder and races away to the fence.
Short and wide outside off, de Kock looks to cut but mistimes it towards cover.
Flatter and around off, de Kock comes forward and defends it towards the off side.
Starts with a full ball on the pads, Bavuma flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Joe Root to bowl now. He has already dismissed Quinton de Kock two times in as many matches of the series. Can he take a hat-trick?
Outside off on a length, de Kock lets it go to the keeper. Good tight over from Jordan, just 3 from it.

Quick run! Full ball around off, Bavuma taps it towards covers and takes off for a single. The non-striker responds and they complete it easily. The fielder from cover tries running de Kock out with a throw at the striker's end but he misses.
Third leave in a row as Jordan bowls one more length ball way outside off.
Another ball in the channel outside off, Temba makes another leave.
Just ahead of a good length and outside off, inviting the batsman to drive. Bavuma though is not lured into it as he lets it go to the keeper.
Shortish and on middle, de Kock hops and tucks it towards the on side for a single.
WIDE! Jordan starts with a length ball down the leg side, de Kock looks to flick but mises. Wided by the umpire.
Powerplay 2 begins! A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Chris Jordan is into the attack now.

FOUR! Lovely timing! Straight drives always look gorgeous and this one was no less. Full ball on middle, Bavuma just strokes it down the ground towards mid on. The ball races away to the fence as the fielders from mid off and mid on chase it. It is the ball that wins the race. End of Powerplay 1 and one would imaging it is a decent one for both the sides. 36/1 at the end of it.
Fuller and around off, Bavuma drives it well but finds the cover fielder.
Good length ball on off, de Kick taps it towards point.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid off.
Full and around off, de Kock pushes it to the left of the man at mid on. Before the fielder can get to the ball, de Kock changes his end.
Full and just outside off, Bavuma looks to drive the ball but it takes the inner half of the bat and goes towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
Quick single! A fuller ball around off, Bavuma pushes it towards covers and takes a quick run.
FOUR! Whipped! Bavuma is off the mark in style! Full and on the pads of Bavuma, he whips it nicely. The ball races away to the deep mid-wicket fence in a jiffy.
WIDE! Slightly shorter one from Curran but it is down the leg side. Bavuma looks to flick but makes no connection. Wided.
Full and outside off,  Bavuma strokes it towards covers.
Fuller and on middle, Bavuma flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
In the channel outside off, Bavuma makes a leave.
Length ball on the pads, de Kock tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
Length ball outside off, Bavuma lets it go to the keeper. End of a successful over from the debutant. 5 and a wicket from it.
Temba Bavuma is in at no. 3.

OUT! Timber! Mahmood has a debut wicket! A special delivery from him to get his first wicket in ODIs. A length ball outside off, it comes back sharply. Hendricks looks to defend but the ball sneaks through the little gap between bat and pad. It goes to the left of Bairstow behind the stumps. There is a little noise as the ball goes to the keeper. Mahmood is up in celebration and Reeza walks back as we see one of the bails is down. Replay shows that the sound was of the ball kissing the bail. The opening stand has been broken and England draw first blood. The pressure they built has its reward.
Slightly shorter in length and outside off, Hendricks pushes it towards mid off.
WIDE! Bouncer down the leg side. Hendricks ducks under it. The umpire stretches his arms and signals it as a wide.
Good length ball on off, Reeza defends it out.
Fullish and around off, Hendricks defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Driven nicely! Mahmood overpitches and bowls it wide outside off, Hendricks leans into the drive and drills it through the cover region for a boundary.
Curran strays on the pads for the first time and de Kock is too good a player to miss out. He whips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller and around off, pushed towards point.

Beaten again! Excellent bowling from Curran. He might be feeling really unlucky because he has gone past de Kock's outside edge on quite a few occasions. Bowls a length ball on middle and makes it go away after pitching. De Kock plays the original line of the delivery to get beaten.
Short and just around off, de Kock pushes it towards point.
Play and a miss! Length ball just around off, de Kock comes forward and looks to drive but the ball moves a tad bit away to beat the outside edge.
Short and outside off, de Kock looks to cut but mistimes it towards the cover fielder.
Shortish and around off, Hendricks stays on the back foot and defends it out. Good over by Mahmood, a maiden.
Another length ball on off, it comes into the right-hander, Hendricks looks to defend but the ball hits him high on the thigh pad.
Good length ball around off, Hendricks comes forward and keeps it out.

Confusion but safe! A length ball around off, Hendricks tucks it towards mid-wicket. De Kock from the other end thinks of the run and takes off but Reeza shows no interest. The fielder from mid-wicket picks the ball and fires the throw at the non-striker's end. He hits but de Kock is well in.
Shortish outside off, comes back in nicely but Hendricks is sure about his sticks as he once again makes a leave.
Slightly fuller and just outside off, asking the batter to drive. Hendricks is not lured into the shot as he allows the ball to go to the keeper.
Good length ball on off, Hendricks works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
This time the length ball is outside off, so Hendricks lets it go to the keeper.
Good length ball around off, Reeza comes forward and blocks it out.
Length ball just outside off, de Kock looks to defend but the ball takes the outer half of the bat and goes to third man for a single.
On the pads of the right-hander, Hendricks tucks it towards fine leg for a run.

Excellent running between the wickets! A full ball around off, de Kock pushes it down the ground. The man from mid on chases it down near the ropes. However, before he can return the ball, the batters take three.
Landed around off on a length, Hendricks blocks it off his back foot to see through the last ball of the over.
Slightly fuller one on the pads, de Kock looks to flick but gets an inside edge on the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and they take a run.
Length ball outside off, Hendricks guides it towards third man for a single.
Length ball angled into the batter this time, Hendricks looks to defend but misses to get hit high on the thigh pad.
Good away movement from Mahmood this time. It is on a length and just outside off, Hendricks lets it go to the keeper.
Slightly short and around off, Hendricks punches it towards covers off his back foot. There is a little fumble from the fielder but it costs nothing.

FOUR! Nicely done! De Kock is off the mark with a nice cut off the back foot. Short and outside off from Curran, de Kock rocks on the back foot and cuts it through point. The ball races away to the fence quickly.
Curran goes wide on a length, de Kock lets it pass to the keeper.
Gets bat on ball for the first time and the crowd cheers. A length delivery just outside off, de Kock comes forward and defends it towards covers.

Another ripper from Curran! Another ball which is on a shortish length on middle, once again it moves off the deck and goes away. De Kock initially thought to play at it but at the very last second, pulled his bat out of the line of the delivery.
In the channel outside off, de Kock this time makes a leave.
Beaten! Curran is bowling really well here. He bowls this one on a shortish length around off, it once again pitches and moves away and de Kock looks to put bat on ball, only to get beaten.
Good length and around off, Hendricks goes on the back foot and blocks it out. Decent first over from the debutant.
Slightly short and around off, Hendricks looks to block but the ball gets big on him. However, he blocks it well with soft hands.
FOUR! Hendricks and South Africa are underway! Short and wide outside off from Mahmood, Hendricks slams it through cover-point to bag his first boundary.
Length ball on the body, Hendricks tucks it towards the on side.
Slightly shortish length just outside off, Hendricks rides the bounce and taps it towards covers.
Good length ball outside off, Hendricks covers his stumps and lets it go to the keeper.
Debutant Saqib Mahmood to bowl from the other end.
Wide outside off on a length, de Kock lets it go to the keeper. Excellent first over from Curran, a maiden to begin with.
Brilliant bowling! This is another length ball around off, de Kock once again hangs his bat to poke at it to get beaten.
In the channel outside off, this time de Kock lets it go to the keeper.
Beaten again! It is another good length ball just around off, it pitches and moves a hint away to beat the outside edge of de Kock's bat.
Beaten! Top delivery! It is just around off on a length. De Kock without any feet movement pokes at it to get beaten.
Curran starts with a shortish length ball outside off, de Kock covers his stumps and lets it be.
Time for the action! The England players are already out in the middle. Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks are the two openers for South Africa. Tom Curran with the ball first up. Here we go...

Quinton de Kock, South Africa skipper, tells that he would've loved to bowl first too. Adds that the wicket is really good one and it will not change throughout the game. Reveals that Lungi Ngidi comes back in as he replaces Bjorn Fortune. Feels that playing Pink ODI is a great occasion and hopes that the bad weather stays away and we get a good game of cricket.

Eoin Morgan, England skipper, says that the decision to bowl first is due to the conditions of the ground. Tells that the ground is good for  chasing. Adds that the shorter boundaries will come into play during the run chase and one needs to be disciplined. Finishes by saying that Pink ODI is an exceptional cause and the players are highly motivated. Reveals that Saqib Mahmood makes ODI debut and Moeen Ali and Adil Rashid are the other two changes in the side.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (C/WK), Reeza Hendricks, Temba Bavuma, Rassie van der Dussen, JJ Smuts, David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Beuran Hendricks, Lungi Ngidi (In for Bjorn Fortuin), Lutho Sipamla, Tabraiz Shamsi.

England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow (WK), Joe Root, Eoin Morgan (C), Joe Denly, Tom Banton, Moeen Ali (In for Sam Curran), Saqib Mahmood (ODI DEBUT) (In for Chris Woakes), Tom Curran, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid (In for Matt Parkinson).
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favor of Eoin Morgan. ENGLAND WILL BOWL FIRST!

An unexpected win for South Africa followed by the rain dance in Durban - That's been the story of this ODI series. With just one last match left, it hands the Proteas a golden opportunity of registering a series win over the reigning world champions. On the flip side, England are left without the option of taking the series but have the chance of avoiding the embarrassment of losing the first series after the high of World Cup. Hello and welcome everyone for the Pink ODI in Johannesburg and be with us as we bring you the coverage.
